purpose.summary: This is a batch reporting program for the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) medical billing system in Japan. It generates monthly aggregate/summary reports (月次帳票 - monthly statement/receipt report) for outpatient visits, processing patient insurance and billing data. It handles calculations for medical fees, co-payments, subsidies, and consumption tax across multiple insurance types.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in a Japanese character encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese text in comments to appear as mojibake. The program is clearly part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software project. The high comment ratio (0.46) reflects extensive revision history comments. The 142 CALL statements suggest a modular architecture with many shared subprograms. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 228190 bytes total.
